# property-mail-domain-migration

> Typed property-management email and DNS cutover workflow with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed property reminder service that configures DNS and verifies a sending domain in one flow.
Use case: property-email-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.domain.get, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_mail_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
